scenes.narration: Anh Minh, vị đầu bếp phở huyền thoại, bất ngờ mất hết cảm nhận hương vị trong một buổi sáng bình yên.
scenes.narration_en: Minh, the legendary pho chef, unexpectedly lost all his sense of taste on a peaceful morning.
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic vertical shot inside a bustling Vietnamese street food kitchen. An elderly Asian man with kind eyes and flour-dusted apron stands solemnly by a large copper pot filled with steaming broth. Soft natural morning light streams through the window, highlighting steam rising gently. No text or subtitles visible.

scenes.narration: Mỗi nguyên liệu anh nêm nếm đều dựa trên trí nhớ sâu thẳm thay vì vị giác còn lại.
scenes.narration_en: Every ingredient he seasons is based on deep memory rather than the remaining sense of taste.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up vertical shot of an elderly Asian man's hands carefully adding star anise and cinnamon sticks into a simmering pot. His expression is focused yet slightly worried. Warm golden hour lighting illuminates his weathered face and traditional wooden kitchen tools in the background. No text.

scenes.narration: Những buổi tối dài, anh ngồi nhìn nồi nước dùng sôi sùng mà không cảm nhận được chút mặn nhạt nào.
scenes.narration_en: On long nights, he sits watching the boiling broth but feels no saltiness or bitterness at all.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of an elderly Asian man sitting alone in a dimly lit kitchen late at night. A large pot bubbles gently on the stove casting orange glow on his tired face reflecting worry and sadness while steam rises around him creating moody atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 'Cảm ơn anh, món này làm con nhớ hương vị bà nội thật sự,' cô cháu gái nhỏ run rẩy nói.
scenes.narration_en: "Thank you, this reminds me truly of my grandmother's taste," the little granddaughter said trembling with emotion.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot showing an elderly Asian man smiling warmly while serving fresh pho to a young Vietnamese girl in traditional clothing. Soft warm lighting fills the rustic kitchen as steam rises between them creating emotional connection without any text overlays.

scenes.narration: 'Cháu cảm ơn,' anh mỉm cười, vì hương vị thực sự nằm trong tình yêu thương chứ không chỉ là giác quan.
scenes.narration_en: "Thank you," he smiled gently, realizing true flavor lies in love rather than just senses.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical close-up of an elderly Asian man wiping tears with a flour-dusted apron while holding a ladle full of rich pho broth. Soft golden sunlight filters through window illuminating his relieved expression and the girl's happy face beside him creating warm emotional moment.

scenes.narration: Anh Minh đã tìm lại vị giác của mình không phải bằng nước ngọt, mà bởi trái tim tràn đầy yêu thương.
scenes.narration_en: Minh regained his taste not through sweet water but by a heart full of love and compassion.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical wide shot showing the elderly Asian man standing proudly next to his famous pho stall with happy customers including children laughing around him. Golden hour sunlight bathes entire scene in warm tones celebrating reunion between chef and community without any visible text
